name: NextShapes
summary: Amazon brand selling 1 kg PETG (high-flow, high-speed, matte) and PLA, mostly as spoolless refills marketed as fitting Bambu Lab printers, at about $10-19/kg. The Amazon seller is a Zhongshan technology company; the extruder is unknown.

product_lines.name: PETG HF / High Speed

product_lines.name: PETG Matte
product_lines.notes: 1 kg spooled and refill, $13.19-17.59; no matte-PETG id exists, so mapped to petg.

additional_notes: Legal entity: zhongshandajiankejiyouxiangongsi (rendering: Zhongshan Dajian Technology Co., Ltd.), Tanzhou Town, Zhongshan, Guangdong; Amazon seller 'NextShapes' (id A20XTI1VP791EX), read 2026-11-06. The listing's Manufacturer field reads 'NextShapes'. Store is Amazon only; no brand website was identified. The first pass found only an unverified supplier listing for a 'NextShapes Technology Co., Ltd.', which does not match the seller entity.
